checks.finding: Fresh C request is consumed NEW to RUNNING before the first HIA call; wrapper refuses busy, finished, quarantined or returned sessions.
Issued sequence is exactly prior plus one and greater than consumed; consumed is set before leaf invocation. Refusal never replays a leaf.
Native and leaf attempts and returns, issued and consumed, last return and terminal status, and written plus omitted rows are cross-checked after the returned boundary.
Full trace buffer increments omitted count without stopping the lifetime plan. The receipt preserves omission. Finite qualification must independently require zero omissions.

C refusal preserves committed raw/frame owners. Unexpected C exceptions are held separately in ctx.external or request word42; they do not replace ctx.raised. Python bookkeeping failures quarantine the same session without guessing a release order.
C requires phase acknowledgement closed, correct mode/status/owned slot or exception, and terminal generator state; Python checks complete returned request and actual raw ownership.

limits: The caller must retain actual generator, parent, admitted images and buffers for the invocation and any quarantine. The wrapper intentionally stores borrowed addresses and is not an independent object registry/owner.
